1	/**
2	 * Critic — live acceptance-criteria evaluator.
3	 *
4	 * Observes ClaudeResultItem events on the bus. For each watched agent that
5	 * completes a turn without error, the Critic spawns a short-lived
6	 * `claude --print --model <haiku-default>` subprocess to ask whether the
7	 * output satisfies the agent's acceptance criteria.
8	 *
9	 * The verdict is *always* published as a CritiqueItem (audit trail). On
10	 * "fail", an AgentTargetedMessageItem is emitted back to the agent as its
11	 * next conversational turn — up to `maxEmissionsPerAgent` times, after which
12	 * corrective messages are suppressed but CritiqueItem-s keep accumulating.
13	 *
14	 * Architectural note: Critic uses the Claude CLI subprocess (same auth path
15	 * as every other agent in this system). It does NOT call the Anthropic SDK
16	 * directly because that would fragment the auth model — Claude Code runs
17	 * via OAuth session, not via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The CLI subprocess inherits
18	 * whatever auth `claude` is configured with, so Critic just works wherever
19	 * `claude` does.
20	 *
21	 * Library-grade: no imports from prd.ts, story-agent.ts, or conductor.ts.
22	 */
23	
24	import { execFile } from "child_process"
25	import { promisify } from "util"
26	
27	import { ContextItem, Participant } from "@mozaik-ai/core"
28	
29	import {
30	    AgentTargetedMessageItem,
31	    ClaudeResultItem,
32	    CritiqueItem,
33	} from "../types.js"
34	
35	const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile)
36	
37	const VERDICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `\
38	You are a strict acceptance-criteria evaluator. You will receive:
39	1. A list of acceptance criteria that must ALL be satisfied.
40	2. The output text produced by an agent.
41	
42	Evaluate whether every criterion is fully satisfied by the output.
43	Respond ONLY with a JSON object — no prose, no markdown fences — in exactly this shape:
44	{"verdict":"pass","reasoning":"…","violated_criteria":[]}
45	or
46	{"verdict":"fail","reasoning":"…","violated_criteria":["criterion A","criterion B"]}
47	
48	Rules:
49	- "verdict" must be "pass" or "fail".
50	- "reasoning" must be a concise explanation (≤ 200 words).
51	- "violated_criteria" must list the exact criterion strings that are NOT satisfied.
52	- If ALL criteria pass, "violated_criteria" must be an empty array.
53	- Do NOT include any text outside the JSON object.`
54	
55	export interface CriticOptions {
56	    /** Map from agentId to its acceptance-criteria strings. */
57	    targets: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>
58	    /** Max corrective AgentTargetedMessageItem-s per agent. Default: 2. */
59	    maxEmissionsPerAgent?: number
60	    /** Claude model used for verdict calls. Default: "haiku". */
61	    model?: string
62	    /** Path to the `claude` binary. Default: "claude" (resolved via PATH). */
63	    claudeBin?: string
64	    /** Per-evaluation timeout in milliseconds. Default: 60_000. */
65	    timeoutMs?: number
66	}
67	
68	export class Critic extends Participant {
69	    private readonly opts: Required<CriticOptions>
70	    /** agentId → number of AgentTargetedMessageItem-s emitted so far. */
71	    private readonly emissions = new Map<string, number>()
72	    /** agentId → number of result turns seen (for CritiqueItem.turn). */
73	    private readonly turnCount = new Map<string, number>()
74	    /**
75	     * Critic's evaluate() spawns an async `claude --print` subprocess.
76	     * Mozaik's deliverContextItem fan-out doesn't await onContextItem's
77	     * returned promise, so we track in-flight evaluations here and let
78	     * callers (e.g. orchestrate()) await `idle()` before tearing down.
79	     */
80	    private readonly pending = new Set<Promise<void>>()
81	
82	    constructor(opts: CriticOptions) {
83	        super()
84	        this.opts = {
85	            maxEmissionsPerAgent: opts.maxEmissionsPerAgent ?? 2,
86	            model: opts.model ?? "haiku",
87	            claudeBin: opts.claudeBin ?? "claude",
88	            timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 60_000,
89	            targets: opts.targets,
90	        }
91	    }
92	
93	    /** Resolves once every in-flight evaluation has emitted its CritiqueItem. */
94	    async idle(): Promise<void> {
95	        await Promise.allSettled([...this.pending])
96	    }
97	
98	    async onContextItem(_source: Participant, item: ContextItem): Promise<void> {
99	        if (!(item instanceof ClaudeResultItem)) return
100	        if (item.isError || !item.resultText) return
101	
102	        const criteria = this.opts.targets.get(item.agentId)
103	        if (!criteria || criteria.length === 0) return
104	
105	        const turn = (this.turnCount.get(item.agentId) ?? 0) + 1
106	        this.turnCount.set(item.agentId, turn)
107	
108	        const work = (async () => {
109	            const { verdict, reasoning, violatedCriteria } = await this.evaluate(
110	                item.resultText!,
111	                criteria,
112	            )
113	
114	            // Always emit audit trail.
115	            const critiqueItem = new CritiqueItem(
116	                item.agentId,
117	                verdict,
118	                reasoning,
119	                violatedCriteria,
120	                turn,
121	                this.opts.model,
122	            )
123	            for (const env of this.getEnvironments()) {
124	                env.deliverContextItem(this, critiqueItem)
125	            }
126	
127	            // Emit corrective message only on fail and under the per-agent cap.
128	            if (verdict === "fail") {
129	                const emitted = this.emissions.get(item.agentId) ?? 0
130	                if (emitted < this.opts.maxEmissionsPerAgent) {
131	                    this.emissions.set(item.agentId, emitted + 1)
132	                    const text = buildCorrectiveMessage(reasoning, violatedCriteria)
133	                    const msg = new AgentTargetedMessageItem(
134	                        item.agentId,
135	                        text,
136	                        { criticTurn: turn, emissionIndex: emitted + 1 },
137	                    )
138	                    for (const env of this.getEnvironments()) {
139	                        env.deliverContextItem(this, msg)
140	                    }
141	                }
142	            }
143	        })()
144	
145	        this.pending.add(work)
146	        work.finally(() => {
147	            this.pending.delete(work)
148	        })
149	
150	        await work
151	    }
152	
153	    private async evaluate(
154	        resultText: string,
155	        criteria: readonly string[],
156	    ): Promise<{
157	        verdict: "pass" | "fail"
158	        reasoning: string
159	        violatedCriteria: string[]
160	    }> {
161	        const prompt = buildEvalPrompt(criteria, resultText)
162	
163	        try {
164	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
165	                this.opts.claudeBin,
166	                [
167	                    "--print",
168	                    "--output-format",
169	                    "json",
170	                    "--model",
171	                    this.opts.model,
172	                    "--permission-mode",
173	                    "bypassPermissions",
174	                    "--system-prompt",
175	                    VERDICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
176	                    "-p",
177	                    prompt,
178	                ],
179	                {
180	                    timeout: this.opts.timeoutMs,
181	                    maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
182	                },
183	            )
184	
185	            // `claude --output-format json` returns one JSON object on stdout
186	            // with a `result` field containing the assistant's text answer
187	            // (per packages/baro-app/scripts/SPIKE-FINDINGS.md).
188	            const wrapper = JSON.parse(stdout) as { result?: string }
189	            const verdictText =
190	                typeof wrapper.result === "string" ? wrapper.result.trim() : ""
191	            if (!verdictText) {
192	                throw new Error("claude returned empty result")
193	            }
194	
195	            const verdictJson = extractVerdictJson(verdictText)
196	            const parsed = JSON.parse(verdictJson) as {
197	                verdict: "pass" | "fail"
198	                reasoning: string
199	                violated_criteria: string[]
200	            }
201	
202	            return {
203	                verdict: parsed.verdict === "pass" ? "pass" : "fail",
204	                reasoning: parsed.reasoning ?? "",
205	                violatedCriteria: Array.isArray(parsed.violated_criteria)
206	                    ? parsed.violated_criteria
207	                    : [],
208	            }
209	        } catch (err) {
210	            return {
211	                verdict: "fail",
212	                reasoning: `Critic LLM call failed: ${String((err as Error)?.message ?? err)}`,
213	                violatedCriteria: ["[critic error — could not evaluate]"],
214	            }
215	        }
216	    }
217	}
218	
219	function buildEvalPrompt(
220	    criteria: readonly string[],
221	    resultText: string,
222	): string {
223	    const criteriaList = criteria
224	        .map((c, i) => `${i + 1}. ${c}`)
225	        .join("\n")
226	    return [
227	        "## Acceptance criteria",
228	        criteriaList,
229	        "",
230	        "## Agent output",
231	        resultText,
232	    ].join("\n")
233	}
234	
235	function buildCorrectiveMessage(
236	    reasoning: string,
237	    violatedCriteria: string[],
238	): string {
239	    const lines: string[] = [
240	        "Your output did not satisfy all acceptance criteria. Please revise.",
241	        "",
242	        `**Reasoning:** ${reasoning}`,
243	    ]
244	    if (violatedCriteria.length > 0) {
245	        lines.push("", "**Violated criteria:**")
246	        for (const c of violatedCriteria) {
247	            lines.push(`- ${c}`)
248	        }
249	    }
250	    lines.push("", "Please address the above and resubmit your work.")
251	    return lines.join("\n")
252	}
253	
254	/**
255	 * Claude's response to the verdict prompt should be just the JSON object,
256	 * but the model occasionally wraps it in a markdown fence or adds a
257	 * leading/trailing sentence even with strict instructions. Tolerate that
258	 * by extracting the first balanced `{...}` block.
259	 */
260	function extractVerdictJson(text: string): string {
261	    const trimmed = text.trim()
262	    if (trimmed.startsWith("{") && trimmed.endsWith("}")) {
263	        return trimmed
264	    }
265	    const fenceMatch = trimmed.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/)
266	    if (fenceMatch) {
267	        return fenceMatch[1]!
268	    }
269	    const start = trimmed.indexOf("{")
270	    if (start < 0) {
271	        throw new Error(`no JSON object found in critic response: ${trimmed.slice(0, 200)}`)
272	    }
273	    let depth = 0
274	    for (let i = start; i < trimmed.length; i++) {
275	        const ch = trimmed[i]
276	        if (ch === "{") depth += 1
277	        else if (ch === "}") {
278	            depth -= 1
279	            if (depth === 0) {
280	                return trimmed.slice(start, i + 1)
281	            }
282	        }
283	    }
284	    throw new Error(`unbalanced JSON object in critic response: ${trimmed.slice(0, 200)}`)
285	}

1	/**
2	 * Surgeon — adaptive DAG mutation participant (Phase 4).
3	 *
4	 * Observes terminal story failures (StoryResultItem with success=false
5	 * after all retries exhausted) and emits ReplanItem-s that the
6	 * Conductor applies at the next level boundary.
7	 *
8	 * Two evaluation strategies:
9	 *
10	 *   • `useLlm: false` (default) — deterministic. When a story fails
11	 *     terminally, Surgeon emits a ReplanItem that REMOVES the failing
12	 *     story so dependents can either run with one fewer prerequisite
13	 *     or themselves be removed by cascade. This is graceful
14	 *     degradation — pre-Phase-4 the entire level (and downstream)
15	 *     would just abort.
16	 *
17	 *   • `useLlm: true` — calls `claude --model <model> --print` with a
18	 *     compact view of the run state and asks for a structured
19	 *     replan (add/remove/rewire stories). The model is given the
20	 *     full failure reason and the surrounding PRD so it can propose
21	 *     a different approach (e.g. split the failed story into two
22	 *     smaller stories, or insert a missing prerequisite).
23	 *
24	 * Library-grade: doesn't import PRD types directly. The Surgeon
25	 * receives PRD context as a generic `() => PrdSnapshot` callback so
26	 * the Conductor stays the only PRD-aware piece of code.
27	 */
28	
29	import { execFile } from "child_process"
30	import { promisify } from "util"
31	
32	import { ContextItem, Participant } from "@mozaik-ai/core"
33	
34	import { ReplanItem, ReplanStoryAdd } from "../types.js"
35	import { StoryResultItem } from "./story-agent.js"
36	
37	const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile)
38	
39	/**
40	 * Lightweight read-only view of the PRD that Surgeon needs to reason.
41	 * The Conductor (or the orchestrate() wiring) provides this snapshot;
42	 * Surgeon doesn't import PrdFile/PrdStory itself.
43	 */
44	export interface PrdSnapshot {
45	    project: string
46	    description: string
47	    stories: readonly {
48	        id: string
49	        title: string
50	        description: string
51	        dependsOn: readonly string[]
52	        passes: boolean
53	    }[]
54	}
55	
56	export interface SurgeonOptions {
57	    /** Returns a fresh snapshot of the current PRD. */
58	    snapshot: () => PrdSnapshot
59	    /** Use Claude CLI to evaluate replans. Default: false (deterministic). */
60	    useLlm?: boolean
61	    /** Model for LLM evaluations. Default: "opus". */
62	    model?: string
63	    /** Max replans this Surgeon will emit per run. Default: 10. */
64	    maxReplans?: number
65	    /** Path to the `claude` binary. Default: "claude". */
66	    claudeBin?: string
67	    /** Per-evaluation timeout in milliseconds. Default: 90_000. */
68	    timeoutMs?: number
69	}

71	const SURGEON_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `\
72	You are the Surgeon — an autonomous planner that adapts a software-project
73	DAG when stories fail. Given:
74	1. A snapshot of the current PRD (project, story list with dependencies +
75	   pass/fail state).
76	2. The id, title, description, and FAILURE REASON of the story that just
77	   exhausted its retry budget.
78	
79	Decide ONE of, in this order of preference:
80	  (a) "split"     — replace the failing story with 2-3 smaller stories
81	                    that together cover its acceptance criteria. Use
82	                    this whenever the failure looks like the story was
83	                    too broad — too many files, too many concerns,
84	                    too much for one Claude session. Strongly preferred
85	                    over removal whenever the goal still needs the work.
86	  (b) "prereq"    — insert ONE OR MORE new prerequisite stories that
87	                    the failing story now depends on, then ALSO add a
88	                    replacement of the failing story (with updated
89	                    dependsOn) so the original work still gets done.
90	                    Removing without replacement is NOT prereq.
91	  (c) "rewire"    — keep the failing story BUT modifyDeps so it runs
92	                    in a different order, or change its dependsOn to
93	                    unblock dependents. Use when the failure was
94	                    timing-related, not scope-related.
95	  (d) "skip"      — last resort. Use ONLY when the story is genuinely
96	                    infeasible (e.g., asks for a library that doesn't
97	                    exist, references files that aren't there). When
98	                    you skip, modifyDeps for any dependents so the
99	                    rest of the run can still complete.
100	  (e) "abort"     — only when the entire run cannot continue.
101	
102	Strong bias: the run is only successful when EVERY original goal item
103	gets done. Splitting into smaller stories is almost always better than
104	dropping. Don't drop just because one attempt failed — propose a
105	different approach.
106	
107	Respond ONLY with a JSON object — no prose, no markdown fences — in
108	exactly this shape:
109	
110	{"action":"split"|"prereq"|"rewire"|"skip"|"abort",
111	 "reason":"…",
112	 "added":[ { "id":"S?","priority":N,"title":"…","description":"…",
113	             "dependsOn":["…"], "acceptance":["…"] } ],
114	 "removed":["S?"],
115	 "modifiedDeps":[{"id":"S?","newDependsOn":["…"]}]}
116	
117	Rules:
118	- Story ids you ADD must not collide with existing ids.
119	- Story ids you REMOVE must currently exist and not yet have passes=true.
120	- "modifiedDeps" rewires a story's dependsOn — use to repoint dependents
121	  of a removed story to a replacement.
122	- "abort" → empty added/removed/modifiedDeps arrays.
123	- Output ONLY the JSON object, nothing else.`
124	
125	export class Surgeon extends Participant {
126	    private readonly opts: Required<
127	        Pick<
128	            SurgeonOptions,
129	            "useLlm" | "model" | "maxReplans" | "claudeBin" | "timeoutMs"
130	        >
131	    > &
132	        SurgeonOptions
133	
134	    private replansEmitted = 0
135	    private readonly pending = new Set<Promise<void>>()
136	
137	    constructor(opts: SurgeonOptions) {
138	        super()
139	        this.opts = {
140	            useLlm: opts.useLlm ?? true,
141	            model: opts.model ?? "opus",
142	            maxReplans: opts.maxReplans ?? 10,
143	            claudeBin: opts.claudeBin ?? "claude",
144	            timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 90_000,
145	            snapshot: opts.snapshot,
146	        }
147	    }
148	
149	    /** Resolves once every in-flight LLM evaluation has completed. */
150	    async idle(): Promise<void> {
151	        await Promise.allSettled([...this.pending])
152	    }
153	
154	    async onContextItem(_source: Participant, item: ContextItem): Promise<void> {
155	        if (!(item instanceof StoryResultItem)) return
156	        if (item.success) return
157	        if (this.replansEmitted >= this.opts.maxReplans) return
158	
159	        const work = (async () => {
160	            const replan = this.opts.useLlm
161	                ? await this.evaluateWithLlm(item)
162	                : this.evaluateDeterministic(item)
163	            if (!replan) return
164	            this.replansEmitted += 1
165	            for (const env of this.getEnvironments()) {
166	                env.deliverContextItem(this, replan)
167	            }
168	        })()
169	
170	        this.pending.add(work)
171	        work.finally(() => this.pending.delete(work))
172	        await work
173	    }
174	
175	    /**
176	     * Deterministic strategy: emit a "skip" — remove the failing story
177	     * so its dependents either run unblocked (if they had multiple
178	     * deps) or get cascade-removed by buildDag's cycle-detection
179	     * skipping (if their only dep is now gone, they become unreachable).
180	     */
181	    private evaluateDeterministic(failure: StoryResultItem): ReplanItem {
182	        return new ReplanItem(
183	            "surgeon",
184	            `deterministic skip: ${failure.storyId} exhausted ${failure.attempts} attempts (${failure.error ?? "no reason"})`,
185	            [],
186	            [failure.storyId],
187	            new Map(),
188	        )
189	    }
190	
191	    /**
192	     * LLM strategy: ask Claude (via CLI subprocess) to propose a replan
193	     * grounded in the PRD snapshot + failure reason. Falls back to
194	     * deterministic on parsing or subprocess error.
195	     */
196	    private async evaluateWithLlm(
197	        failure: StoryResultItem,
198	    ): Promise<ReplanItem | null> {
199	        const snap = this.opts.snapshot()
200	        const prompt = buildSurgeonPrompt(snap, failure)
201	        try {
202	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
203	                this.opts.claudeBin,
204	                [
205	                    "--print",
206	                    "--output-format",
207	                    "json",
208	                    "--model",
209	                    this.opts.model,
210	                    "--permission-mode",
211	                    "bypassPermissions",
212	                    "--system-prompt",
213	                    SURGEON_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
214	                    "-p",
215	                    prompt,
216	                ],
217	                {
218	                    timeout: this.opts.timeoutMs,
219	                    maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
220	                },
221	            )
222	            const wrapper = JSON.parse(stdout) as { result?: string }
223	            const verdictText =
224	                typeof wrapper.result === "string" ? wrapper.result.trim() : ""
225	            if (!verdictText) throw new Error("empty result")
226	
227	            const verdictJson = extractJsonObject(verdictText)
228	            const parsed = JSON.parse(verdictJson) as {
229	                action: string
230	                reason?: string
231	                added?: ReplanStoryAdd[]
232	                removed?: string[]
233	                modifiedDeps?: { id: string; newDependsOn: string[] }[]
234	            }
235	
236	            if (parsed.action === "abort") return null
237	
238	            const modifiedDeps = new Map<string, readonly string[]>()
239	            for (const m of parsed.modifiedDeps ?? []) {
240	                if (typeof m.id === "string" && Array.isArray(m.newDependsOn)) {
241	                    modifiedDeps.set(m.id, [...m.newDependsOn])
242	                }
243	            }
244	            return new ReplanItem(
245	                "surgeon",
246	                `${parsed.action}: ${parsed.reason ?? ""}`,
247	                parsed.added ?? [],
248	                parsed.removed ?? [],
249	                modifiedDeps,
250	            )
251	        } catch (err) {
252	            // Fall back to deterministic on any LLM-side failure so the
253	            // run still has a chance to recover.
254	            const fallback = this.evaluateDeterministic(failure)
255	            return new ReplanItem(
256	                fallback.source,
257	                `${fallback.reason} (llm fallback after error: ${(err as Error)?.message ?? String(err)})`,
258	                fallback.addedStories,
259	                fallback.removedStoryIds,
260	                fallback.modifiedDeps,
261	            )
262	        }
263	    }
264	}
265	
266	function buildSurgeonPrompt(
267	    snap: PrdSnapshot,
268	    failure: StoryResultItem,
269	): string {
270	    const storyLines = snap.stories
271	        .map(
272	            (s) =>
273	                `  - ${s.id} ${s.passes ? "[passed]" : "[pending]"} "${s.title}" deps=${JSON.stringify(s.dependsOn)}`,
274	        )
275	        .join("\n")
276	    const failureStory = snap.stories.find((s) => s.id === failure.storyId)
277	    return [
278	        `# Project: ${snap.project}`,
279	        `Description: ${snap.description}`,
280	        "",
281	        `# Current PRD`,
282	        storyLines,
283	        "",
284	        `# Failure`,
285	        `Story id: ${failure.storyId}`,
286	        `Title: ${failureStory?.title ?? "(unknown)"}`,
287	        `Description: ${failureStory?.description ?? "(unknown)"}`,
288	        `Attempts: ${failure.attempts}`,
289	        `Error: ${failure.error ?? "(no reason captured)"}`,
290	        "",
291	        `# Decide`,
292	        `Output the replan JSON per the rules in your system prompt.`,
293	    ].join("\n")
294	}
295	
296	function extractJsonObject(text: string): string {
297	    const trimmed = text.trim()
298	    if (trimmed.startsWith("{") && trimmed.endsWith("}")) return trimmed
299	    const fenceMatch = trimmed.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/)
300	    if (fenceMatch) return fenceMatch[1]!
301	    const start = trimmed.indexOf("{")
302	    if (start < 0) {
303	        throw new Error(`no JSON object found in surgeon response`)
304	    }
305	    let depth = 0
306	    for (let i = start; i < trimmed.length; i++) {
307	        const ch = trimmed[i]
308	        if (ch === "{") depth += 1
309	        else if (ch === "}") {
310	            depth -= 1
311	            if (depth === 0) return trimmed.slice(start, i + 1)
312	        }
313	    }
314	    throw new Error("unbalanced JSON object in surgeon response")
315	}

1	/**
2	 * Conductor — Mozaik-native event-driven orchestrator.
3	 *
4	 * No `run()` method. No `await Promise.all`. No imperative `while` loop.
5	 * Conductor is a pure state machine: it observes bus events via
6	 * `onContextItem` and emits orchestration events back. The Mozaik
7	 * runtime drives the loop; Conductor just transitions state.
8	 *
9	 * State machine:
10	 *
11	 *   ┌──────────┐    RunStartRequest    ┌───────────┐
12	 *   │   idle   │ ────────────────────► │ launching │
13	 *   └──────────┘                       └─────┬─────┘
14	 *                                            │ emit RunStartedItem
15	 *                                            │ emit LevelComputeRequestItem
16	 *                                            ▼
17	 *                                      ┌───────────┐
18	 *                       LevelComputeReq│ computing │
19	 *                                ┌──────┤   level   │
20	 *                                │      └─────┬─────┘
21	 *                                │            │ buildDag → next level
22	 *                                │            │ emit LevelStartedItem
23	 *                                │            │ emit StorySpawnRequestItem* (for each story)
24	 *                                │            ▼
25	 *                                │      ┌───────────┐
26	 *                                │      │  running  │ ←── StoryResultItem
27	 *                                │      │   level   │     (one per story in level)
28	 *                                │      └─────┬─────┘
29	 *                                │            │ all stories in level done
30	 *                                │            │ emit LevelCompletedItem
31	 *                                │            │ apply pending replans
32	 *                                │            │ emit LevelComputeRequestItem
33	 *                                └────────────┘
34	 *
35	 *   When buildDag returns 0 levels → emit RunCompletedItem.
36	 *   When a level has all-failed-no-replan → emit RunCompletedItem(success=false).
37	 */

238	    private async handleRunStart(): Promise<void> {

331	    private async handleStoryResult(item: StoryResultItem): Promise<void> {
332	        if (this.phase !== "running") return

334	        if (!this.currentLevel.pending.has(item.storyId)) return

339	        this.totalAttempts += item.attempts

344	            if (this.prd) {

354	                            "running_level",
355	                            `onStoryPassed hook for ${item.storyId} failed: ${(e as Error)?.message ?? String(e)}`,
356	                            this.currentLevel.ordinal,
357	                            this.currentLevel.totalLevelsHint,
358	                        ),
359	                    )
360	                }
361	            }
362	        } else {
363	            this.currentLevel.failed.push(item.storyId)
364	            this.globalFailed.push(item.storyId)
365	        }
366	
367	        // Try to fill freed parallel slots with queued stories.
368	        await this.fillSpawnSlots()
369	
370	        // If all stories in this level are settled, transition to level boundary.
371	        if (this.currentLevel.pending.size === 0) {
372	            await this.completeLevel()
373	        }
374	    }
375	
376	    private async fillSpawnSlots(): Promise<void> {
377	        if (!this.currentLevel) return
378	        const cap =
379	            this.opts.parallel > 0 ? this.opts.parallel : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
380	        while (this.spawnQueue.length > 0 && this.inFlight.size < cap) {
381	            const story = this.spawnQueue.shift()!
382	            await this.requestStorySpawn(story)
383	        }
384	    }
385	
386	    private async requestStorySpawn(story: PrdStory): Promise<void> {
387	        const model =
388	            this.opts.overrideModel ?? story.model ?? this.opts.defaultModel
389	        let prompt = this.resolvePrompt(story)
390	
391	        if (this.opts.onBeforeStoryLaunch) {
392	            try {
393	                const extra = await this.opts.onBeforeStoryLaunch(story.id, story)
394	                if (typeof extra === "string" && extra.trim().length > 0) {
395	                    prompt = `${extra.trim()}\n\n${prompt}`
396	                }
397	            } catch (e) {
398	                this.emit(
399	                    new ConductorStateItem(
400	                        "running_level",
401	                        `onBeforeStoryLaunch hook for ${story.id} failed: ${(e as Error)?.message ?? String(e)}`,
402	                    ),
403	                )
404	            }
405	        }
406	
407	        this.inFlight.add(story.id)
408	        this.emit(
409	            new StorySpawnRequestItem(
410	                story.id,
411	                prompt,
412	                model,
413	                story.retries,
414	                this.opts.timeoutSecs,
415	            ),
416	        )
417	    }
418	
419	    private async completeLevel(): Promise<void> {
420	        if (!this.currentLevel) return
421	        const lvl = this.currentLevel
422	
423	        this.emit(
424	            new LevelCompletedItem(lvl.ordinal, lvl.passed, lvl.failed),
425	        )
426	        this.emit(
427	            new ConductorStateItem(
428	                "level_complete",
429	                `passed ${lvl.passed.length}/${lvl.passed.length + lvl.failed.length}`,
430	                lvl.ordinal,
431	                lvl.totalLevelsHint,
432	                lvl.storyIds,
433	            ),
434	        )
435	
436	        // Apply ReplanItem-s buffered during this level.
437	        let replannedThisLevel = false
438	        if (this.pendingReplans.length > 0 && this.prd) {
439	            const drained = this.pendingReplans.splice(0)
440	            for (const replan of drained) {
441	                this.prd = applyReplan(this.prd, replan)
442	                this.appliedReplans += 1
443	                replannedThisLevel = true
444	                // Track stories that were removed without a replacement.
445	                // If the replan only removes (no addedStories), it's a
446	                // drop — the work is gone and the run should NOT report
447	                // success. If the replan also adds stories, it's a true
448	                // replan; the failing story has been supplanted.
449	                if (replan.removedStoryIds.length > 0) {
450	                    const removeSet = new Set(replan.removedStoryIds)
451	                    // Failing stories that the replan replaces should
452	                    // come off globalFailed iff there's actually
453	                    // replacement work to track instead.
454	                    if (replan.addedStories.length > 0) {
455	                        for (let i = this.globalFailed.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
456	                            if (removeSet.has(this.globalFailed[i])) {
457	                                this.globalFailed.splice(i, 1)
458	                            }
459	                        }
460	                    } else {
461	                        // Pure drop — record so terminateRun knows the
462	                        // run did not actually complete the goal.
463	                        for (const id of replan.removedStoryIds) {
464	                            if (!this.globalDropped.includes(id)) {
465	                                this.globalDropped.push(id)
466	                            }
467	                        }
468	                    }
469	                }
470	                this.emit(
471	                    new ConductorStateItem(
472	                        "running_level",
473	                        `replan applied (source=${replan.source}, +${replan.addedStories.length}/-${replan.removedStoryIds.length}): ${replan.reason}`,
474	                        lvl.ordinal,
475	                    ),
476	                )
477	            }
478	            savePrd(this.opts.prdPath, this.prd)
479	        }
480	
481	        // If every story in the level failed terminally AND no replan
482	        // mutated the plan in response, abort the run.
483	        const anySuccess = lvl.passed.length > 0
484	        const totalThisLevel = lvl.passed.length + lvl.failed.length
485	        if (!anySuccess && totalThisLevel > 0 && !replannedThisLevel) {
486	            this.terminateRun(
487	                false,
488	                "all stories in level failed; aborting remaining levels",
489	            )
490	            return
491	        }
492	
493	        // Loop: ask for next level via the bus.
494	        this.phase = "computing"
495	        this.emit(new LevelComputeRequestItem("level boundary"))
496	    }
497	
498	    private terminateRun(success: boolean, abortReason: string | null): void {
499	        if (this.phase === "done") return
500	        this.phase = "done"
501	        const totalDurationSecs = Math.round((Date.now() - this.startedAt) / 1000)
502	
503	        const droppedSegment = this.globalDropped.length > 0
504	            ? `, ${this.globalDropped.length} dropped`
505	            : ""
506	        this.emit(
507	            new ConductorStateItem(
508	                success ? "done" : "failed",
509	                abortReason ??
510	                    `${this.globalCompleted.length} passed, ${this.globalFailed.length} failed${droppedSegment} in ${totalDurationSecs}s`,
511	            ),
512	        )
513	
514	        const summary: ConductorRunSummary = {
515	            success,
516	            abortReason,
517	            completedStories: [...this.globalCompleted],
518	            failedStories: [...this.globalFailed],
519	            droppedStories: [...this.globalDropped],
520	            totalDurationSecs,
521	            totalAttempts: this.totalAttempts,
522	        }
523	
524	        this.emit(
525	            new RunCompletedItem(
526	                success,
527	                summary.completedStories,
528	                summary.failedStories,
529	                totalDurationSecs,
530	                this.totalAttempts,
531	                abortReason,
532	            ),
533	        )
534	
535	        // onRunComplete hook is fired and-then-forget; the resolve happens
536	        // synchronously so callers awaiting `done` aren't blocked by hook
537	        // side-effects.
538	        if (this.opts.onRunComplete) {
539	            void Promise.resolve(this.opts.onRunComplete(summary)).catch(() => {})
540	        }
541	        this.resolveDone(summary)
542	    }
543	
544	    private resolvePrompt(story: PrdStory): string {
545	        const candidatePath =
546	            this.opts.promptTemplatePath ?? join(this.opts.cwd, "prompt.md")
547	        if (existsSync(candidatePath)) {
548	            const tpl = readFileSyncSafe(candidatePath)
549	            if (tpl) {
550	                return applyTemplate(tpl, story)
551	            }
552	        }
553	        return buildDefaultStoryPrompt(story)
554	    }
555	
556	    private emit(item: ContextItem): void {
557	        this.envRef?.deliverContextItem(this, item)
558	    }
559	}
560	
561	/**
562	 * Pure: apply a ReplanItem to a PrdFile and return a new PrdFile.
563	 * Removes pending stories, rewires deps, adds new stories.
564	 * Stories that have already passed are never removed.
565	 */
566	export function applyReplan(prd: PrdFile, replan: ReplanItem): PrdFile {
567	    let stories = prd.userStories.slice()
568	
569	    if (replan.removedStoryIds.length > 0) {
570	        const removeSet = new Set(replan.removedStoryIds)
571	        stories = stories.filter((s) => !removeSet.has(s.id) || s.passes)
572	    }
573	
574	    if (replan.modifiedDeps.size > 0) {
575	        stories = stories.map((s) => {
576	            const newDeps = replan.modifiedDeps.get(s.id)
577	            if (!newDeps) return s
578	            return { ...s, dependsOn: [...newDeps] }
579	        })
580	    }
581	
582	    if (replan.addedStories.length > 0) {
583	        const existing = new Set(stories.map((s) => s.id))
584	        for (const a of replan.addedStories) {
585	            if (existing.has(a.id)) continue
586	            stories.push({
587	                id: a.id,
588	                priority: a.priority,
589	                title: a.title,
590	                description: a.description,
591	                dependsOn: [...a.dependsOn],
592	                retries: a.retries ?? 2,
593	                acceptance: a.acceptance ? [...a.acceptance] : [],
594	                tests: a.tests ? [...a.tests] : [],
595	                passes: false,
596	                completedAt: null,
597	                durationSecs: null,
598	                model: a.model,
599	            })
600	        }
601	    }
602	
603	    return { ...prd, userStories: stories }
604	}
605	
606	function readFileSyncSafe(path: string): string | null {
607	    try {
608	        return readFileSync(path, "utf8")
609	    } catch {
610	        return null
611	    }
612	}
613	
614	function applyTemplate(tpl: string, story: PrdStory): string {
615	    const acceptance = story.acceptance.length
616	        ? story.acceptance.map((a, i) => `${i + 1}. ${a}`).join("\n")
617	        : "(none specified)"
618	    return tpl
619	        .replace(/STORY_ID/g, story.id)
620	        .replace(/STORY_TITLE/g, story.title)
621	        .replace(/STORY_DESCRIPTION/g, story.description)
622	        .replace(/ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA/g, acceptance)
623	}

1	/**
2	 * Librarian — cross-agent runtime memory observer.
3	 *
4	 * Listens to FunctionCallItem (the tool call) and FunctionCallOutputItem
5	 * (its result) on the bus, extracts knowledge from "exploration" tools
6	 * (Read, Grep, Bash, Glob, LSP), and indexes it by tags so future
7	 * stories can pick it up before they re-do the same work.
8	 *
9	 * Two consumption surfaces:
10	 *
11	 *   1. `gatherContext(storyId, hints?)` — RPC-style accessor used by
12	 *      Conductor's `onBeforeStoryLaunch` hook to augment a story's
13	 *      initial prompt. Returns a single text blob suitable for
14	 *      prepending. This is the Phase-2 integration point: prompts
15	 *      pick up cross-agent findings without any timing dance.
16	 *
17	 *   2. KnowledgeItem-s on the bus — emitted whenever a new finding is
18	 *      indexed, so other observers can react. (Phase-3 multi-turn
19	 *      agents will inject these mid-flight.)
20	 *
21	 * Library-grade: no PRD knowledge, no story specifics.
22	 */
23	
24	import {
25	    ContextItem,
26	    FunctionCallItem,
27	    FunctionCallOutputItem,
28	    Participant,
29	} from "@mozaik-ai/core"
30	
31	import { KnowledgeItem } from "../types.js"
32	
33	/** Tools whose results are worth capturing for cross-agent reuse. */
34	const EXPLORATION_TOOLS = new Set([
35	    "Read",
36	    "Grep",
37	    "Glob",
38	    "Bash",
39	    "LSP",
40	    "WebFetch",
41	    "WebSearch",
42	])
43	
44	interface PendingCall {
45	    agentId: string
46	    tool: string
47	    args: Record<string, unknown>
48	    tags: string[]
49	    summary: string
50	}
51	
52	interface IndexedKnowledge {
53	    sourceAgentId: string
54	    tool: string
55	    tags: string[]
56	    summary: string
57	    content: string
58	}
59	
60	export interface LibrarianOptions {
61	    /**
62	     * Cap the body of each indexed entry to this many characters
63	     * (truncated with a marker). Default: 4000.
64	     */
65	    maxContentChars?: number
66	    /**
67	     * Cap the total injected context per story to this many characters.
68	     * Default: 8000.
69	     */
70	    maxInjectedChars?: number
71	}
72	
73	export class Librarian extends Participant {
74	    private readonly opts: Required<LibrarianOptions>
75	    private readonly pending = new Map<string, PendingCall>()
76	    private readonly knowledge: IndexedKnowledge[] = []
77	
78	    constructor(opts: LibrarianOptions = {}) {
79	        super()
80	        this.opts = {
81	            maxContentChars: opts.maxContentChars ?? 4000,
82	            maxInjectedChars: opts.maxInjectedChars ?? 8000,
83	        }
84	    }
85	
86	    /** All indexed knowledge entries, in order discovered. */
87	    getKnowledge(): readonly IndexedKnowledge[] {
88	        return this.knowledge
89	    }
90	
91	    /**
92	     * Build a context blob to prepend to a new story's prompt. Returns
93	     * `null` if there's nothing relevant. Hints (e.g. tags from the
94	     * story title/description) bias relevance ranking.
95	     */
96	    gatherContext(storyId: string, hints: readonly string[] = []): string | null {
97	        if (this.knowledge.length === 0) return null
98	
99	        // Skip findings the story itself produced — we only inject
100	        // *cross-agent* knowledge.
101	        const candidates = this.knowledge.filter(
102	            (k) => k.sourceAgentId !== storyId,
103	        )
104	        if (candidates.length === 0) return null
105	
106	        // Rank by hint overlap (strict substring match, case-insensitive).
107	        const lowerHints = hints.map((h) => h.toLowerCase())
108	        const scored = candidates.map((k) => {
109	            const haystack = (k.summary + " " + k.tags.join(" ")).toLowerCase()
110	            const score = lowerHints.reduce(
111	                (acc, h) => acc + (haystack.includes(h) ? 1 : 0),
112	                0,
113	            )
114	            return { k, score }
115	        })
116	        scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
117	
118	        const lines: string[] = []
119	        let total = 0
120	        for (const { k } of scored) {
121	            const block = formatEntry(k)
122	            if (total + block.length > this.opts.maxInjectedChars) {
123	                lines.push("[…librarian truncated remaining findings…]")
124	                break
125	            }
126	            lines.push(block)
127	            total += block.length
128	        }
129	
130	        if (lines.length === 0) return null
131	        return [
132	            "[librarian] Findings from prior agents in this run that may save",
133	            "you time. Do not re-fetch what's already here unless you suspect",
134	            "the file changed.",
135	            "",
136	            ...lines,
137	        ].join("\n")
138	    }
139	
140	    async onContextItem(source: Participant, item: ContextItem): Promise<void> {
141	        if (item instanceof FunctionCallItem) {
142	            this.recordPending(source, item)
143	            return
144	        }
145	        if (item instanceof FunctionCallOutputItem) {
146	            this.completeWithOutput(source, item)
147	            return
148	        }
149	    }
150	
151	    private recordPending(source: Participant, item: FunctionCallItem): void {
152	        if (!EXPLORATION_TOOLS.has(item.name)) return
153	        const agentId = (source as unknown as { agentId?: string }).agentId
154	        if (typeof agentId !== "string") return
155	        let parsedArgs: Record<string, unknown> = {}
156	        try {
157	            parsedArgs = JSON.parse(item.args) as Record<string, unknown>
158	        } catch {
159	            // ignore malformed arg JSON; we'll still record summary
160	        }
161	        const { tags, summary } = describeCall(item.name, parsedArgs)
162	        this.pending.set(item.callId, {
163	            agentId,
164	            tool: item.name,
165	            args: parsedArgs,
166	            tags,
167	            summary,
168	        })
169	    }
170	
171	    private completeWithOutput(
172	        source: Participant,
173	        item: FunctionCallOutputItem,
174	    ): void {
175	        const json = item.toJSON() as {
176	            call_id: string
177	            output: Array<{ text: string }>
178	        }
179	        const pending = this.pending.get(json.call_id)
180	        if (!pending) return
181	        this.pending.delete(json.call_id)
182	
183	        const fullOutput = json.output.map((b) => b.text).join("\n")
184	        const content =
185	            fullOutput.length > this.opts.maxContentChars
186	                ? fullOutput.slice(0, this.opts.maxContentChars) +
187	                  "\n[…librarian truncated…]"
188	                : fullOutput
189	
190	        const entry: IndexedKnowledge = {
191	            sourceAgentId: pending.agentId,
192	            tool: pending.tool,
193	            tags: pending.tags,
194	            summary: pending.summary,
195	            content,
196	        }
197	        this.knowledge.push(entry)
198	
199	        // Surface as a bus event for any other observers (and Phase-3
200	        // mid-flight injectors).
201	        for (const env of this.getEnvironments()) {
202	            env.deliverContextItem(
203	                this,
204	                new KnowledgeItem(
205	                    entry.sourceAgentId,
206	                    entry.tags,
207	                    entry.summary,
208	                    entry.content,
209	                    entry.tool,
210	                ),
211	            )
212	        }
213	    }
214	}
215	
216	function describeCall(
217	    tool: string,
218	    args: Record<string, unknown>,
219	): { tags: string[]; summary: string } {
220	    const tags: string[] = [tool.toLowerCase()]
221	    let summary = `${tool} call`
222	
223	    if (tool === "Read") {
224	        const path = stringArg(args, "file_path") ?? stringArg(args, "path")
225	        if (path) {
226	            summary = `Read ${path}`
227	            tags.push(path)
228	            const base = path.split("/").pop()
229	            if (base) tags.push(base)
230	        }
231	    } else if (tool === "Grep") {
232	        const pattern = stringArg(args, "pattern")
233	        const path = stringArg(args, "path")
234	        summary = `Grep '${pattern ?? "?"}'${path ? ` in ${path}` : ""}`
235	        if (pattern) tags.push(pattern)
236	        if (path) tags.push(path)
237	    } else if (tool === "Glob") {
238	        const pattern = stringArg(args, "pattern")
239	        summary = `Glob '${pattern ?? "?"}'`
240	        if (pattern) tags.push(pattern)
241	    } else if (tool === "Bash") {
242	        const cmd = stringArg(args, "command")
243	        summary = `Bash ${truncate(cmd ?? "", 80)}`
244	        if (cmd) tags.push(cmd.split(/\s+/)[0] ?? "")
245	    } else if (tool === "WebFetch") {
246	        const url = stringArg(args, "url")
247	        summary = `WebFetch ${url ?? "?"}`
248	        if (url) tags.push(url)
249	    } else if (tool === "WebSearch") {
250	        const q = stringArg(args, "query")
251	        summary = `WebSearch '${truncate(q ?? "", 60)}'`
252	        if (q) tags.push(q)
253	    }
254	    return { tags: tags.filter((t) => t.length > 0), summary }
255	}
256	
257	function stringArg(
258	    args: Record<string, unknown>,
259	    key: string,
260	): string | undefined {
261	    const v = args[key]
262	    return typeof v === "string" ? v : undefined
263	}
264	
265	function truncate(s: string, n: number): string {
266	    return s.length > n ? `${s.slice(0, n)}…` : s
267	}
268	
269	function formatEntry(k: IndexedKnowledge): string {
270	    return [
271	        `--- [${k.sourceAgentId}] ${k.summary} ---`,
272	        k.content,
273	        "",
274	    ].join("\n")
275	}

3	 *

12	 * (Claude tools run inside the CLI subprocess; preempting requires
13	 * Phase-5 PreToolUse hooks). The point is to surface the overlap so

15	 * in real runs.
16	 *
17	 * Library-grade: no PRD knowledge.
18	 */

20	import {
21	    ContextItem,
22	    FunctionCallItem,

24	} from "@mozaik-ai/core"
25

31	    agentId: string
32	    path: string
33	    tool: string
34	    at: number
35	}

38	    /**
39	     * If true, emit a CoordinationItem with kind="notice" the first
40	     * time two agents touch the same file in this run. Default: true.
41	     */
42	    emitNotice?: boolean
43	    /**
44	     * If provided, called whenever an overlap is detected. Mostly for
45	     * tests / metrics.
46	     */
47	    onOverlap?: (info: {
48	        path: string
49	        agents: string[]
50	    }) => void
51	}

54	    private readonly opts: Required<Pick<SentryOptions, "emitNotice">> &
55	        SentryOptions
56	    /** path → set of agentIds that have touched it. */
57	    private readonly touchedBy = new Map<string, Set<string>>()
58	    /** agentId → terminal phase reached (so we know who's still active). */
59	    private readonly terminalPhase = new Map<string, string>()
60	    /** Notices we've already emitted, keyed by `path`. */
61	    private readonly noticedPaths = new Set<string>()
62	    /** History of all touches for post-run inspection / tests. */
63	    private readonly touches: PendingTouch[] = []
64	
65	    constructor(opts: SentryOptions = {}) {
66	        super()
67	        this.opts = {
68	            emitNotice: opts.emitNotice ?? true,
69	            ...opts,
70	        }
71	    }
72	
73	    getTouches(): readonly PendingTouch[] {
74	        return this.touches
75	    }
76	
77	    async onContextItem(source: Participant, item: ContextItem): Promise<void> {
78	        if (item instanceof AgentStateItem) {
79	            if (
80	                item.phase === "done" ||
81	                item.phase === "failed" ||
82	                item.phase === "aborted"
83	            ) {
84	                this.terminalPhase.set(item.agentId, item.phase)
85	            }
86	            return
87	        }
88	
89	        if (item instanceof FunctionCallItem) {
90	            if (!WRITE_TOOLS.has(item.name)) return
91	            const agentId = (source as unknown as { agentId?: string }).agentId
92	            if (typeof agentId !== "string") return
93	            const path = extractPath(item)
94	            if (!path) return
95	
96	            const touch: PendingTouch = {
97	                agentId,
98	                path,
99	                tool: item.name,
100	                at: Date.now(),
101	            }
102	            this.touches.push(touch)
103	
104	            const set = this.touchedBy.get(path) ?? new Set<string>()
105	            set.add(agentId)
106	            this.touchedBy.set(path, set)
107	
108	            // Flag overlap: another agent has already touched this path
109	            // and hasn't reached a terminal phase, OR has reached a
110	            // terminal phase but during this run.
111	            const otherAgents = [...set].filter((a) => a !== agentId)
112	            if (otherAgents.length === 0) return
113	
114	            this.opts.onOverlap?.({
115	                path,
116	                agents: [agentId, ...otherAgents],
117	            })
118	
119	            if (!this.opts.emitNotice || this.noticedPaths.has(path)) {
120	                return
121	            }
122	            this.noticedPaths.add(path)
123	
124	            const reason = `agents [${[agentId, ...otherAgents].join(", ")}] both touched ${path}`
125	            for (const env of this.getEnvironments()) {
126	                env.deliverContextItem(
127	                    this,
128	                    new CoordinationItem(
129	                        agentId,
130	                        otherAgents[0]!,
131	                        "notice",
132	                        reason,
133	                        { path, agents: [agentId, ...otherAgents] },
134	                    ),
135	                )
136	            }
137	            return
138	        }
139	    }
140	}

143	    let args: Record<string, unknown>
144	    try {

148	    }

150	    for (const key of ["file_path", "path", "notebook_path"]) {
151	        const v = args[key]
152	        if (typeof v === "string") return v
153	    }
154	    return null
155	}

20	 *      entire story across all attempts, aborting Claude unconditionally.

221	    private async executeAllAttempts(): Promise<void> {

281	                    break

349	            try {

351	            } catch {
352	                // ignore
353	            }
354	            claude.leave(this.envRef)

357	        }

359	        cancelMultiTurn()

365	            summary.error == null &&
366	            summary.lastResult != null &&

373	                  ? `claude reported isError on result:${summary.lastResult.subtype}`
374	                  : `non-zero exit ${summary.exitCode}`
375	            return { success: false, summary, error: reason }
376	        }

381	    /**
382	     * Wires up the multi-turn quiet timer and turn counter for one attempt.
383	     * Returns a cancel function that stops the timer and clears callbacks
384	     * without closing stdin (used when aborting due to timeout/error).
385	     */
386	    private setupMultiTurnLifecycle(claude: ClaudeCliParticipant): () => void {
387	        let turnsObserved = 0
388	        let quietTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
389	        let finished = false
390	
391	        const finish = () => {
392	            if (finished) return
393	            finished = true
394	            if (quietTimer) { clearTimeout(quietTimer); quietTimer = null }
395	            this.notifyStoryResult = null
396	            this.notifyStoryMessage = null
397	            claude.closeStdin()
398	        }
399	
400	        const resetQuietTimer = () => {
401	            if (quietTimer) clearTimeout(quietTimer)
402	            quietTimer = setTimeout(finish, this.spec.quietTimeoutMs)
403	        }
404	
405	        this.notifyStoryResult = () => {
406	            turnsObserved++
407	            if (turnsObserved >= this.spec.maxTurns) {
408	                finish()
409	            } else {
410	                resetQuietTimer()
411	            }
412	        }
413	
414	        // Reset the timer when a message is injected, but only once the
415	        // first result has arrived (timer already started).
416	        this.notifyStoryMessage = () => {
417	            if (quietTimer !== null) resetQuietTimer()
418	        }
419	
420	        return () => {
421	            if (finished) return
422	            finished = true
423	            if (quietTimer) { clearTimeout(quietTimer); quietTimer = null }
424	            this.notifyStoryResult = null
425	            this.notifyStoryMessage = null
426	            // Caller is responsible for aborting the process.
427	        }
428	    }
429	
430	    private emitStoryResult(
431	        success: boolean,
432	        attempts: number,
433	        durationSecs: number,
434	        error: string | null,
435	    ): void {
436	        if (!this.envRef) return
437	        this.envRef.deliverContextItem(
438	            this,
439	            new StoryResultItem(this.spec.id, success, attempts, durationSecs, error),
440	        )
441	    }
442	
443	    private transition(next: AgentPhase, detail?: string): void {
444	        if (next === this.currentPhase) return
445	        this.currentPhase = next
446	        if (this.envRef) {
447	            this.envRef.deliverContextItem(
448	                this,
449	                new AgentStateItem(this.spec.id, next, detail),
450	            )
451	        }
452	    }
453	}

455	function raceWithTimeout<T>(
456	    p: Promise<T>,
457	    ms: number,
458	    label: string,
459	): Promise<T> {
460	    return Promise.race([
461	        p,
462	        new Promise<T>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(label)), ms)),
463	    ])
464	}

44	
45	const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile)
46	
47	export interface FinalizerOptions {
48	    cwd: string
49	    prdPath: string
50	    /** Optional explicit base SHA. If omitted, captured from RunStartedItem flow. */
51	    baseSha?: string | null
52	    /**
53	     * If false, Finalizer collects events but skips the `gh pr create`
54	     * call. Useful for tests. Default: true.
55	     */
56	    createPr?: boolean
57	    /** Optional logger; receives single-line strings without a trailing newline. */
58	    onLog?: (line: string) => void
59	}
60	
61	interface StoryRecord {
62	    id: string
63	    title: string
64	    success: boolean | null
65	    durationSecs: number | null
66	    attempts: number
67	    levelOrdinal: number | null
68	}
69	
70	export class Finalizer extends Participant {
71	    private readonly opts: Required<Omit<FinalizerOptions, "baseSha" | "onLog">> &
72	        Pick<FinalizerOptions, "onLog">
73	    private envRef: AgenticEnvironment | null = null
74	
75	    private startedAtMs: number | null = null
76	    private baseSha: string | null
77	    private branchName: string | null = null
78	    private levels: string[][] = []
79	    private readonly stories = new Map<string, StoryRecord>()
80	    /**
81	     * Resolves once finalize() has completed (or been short-circuited).
82	     * Lets orchestrate.ts gate its TUI `done` event so the PR URL lands
83	     * in the completion screen instead of after it.
84	     */
85	    private finalizePromise: Promise<void> | null = null
86	
87	    constructor(opts: FinalizerOptions) {
88	        super()
89	        this.opts = {
90	            cwd: opts.cwd,
91	            prdPath: opts.prdPath,
92	            createPr: opts.createPr ?? true,
93	            onLog: opts.onLog,
94	        }
95	        this.baseSha = opts.baseSha ?? null
96	    }
97	
98	    setEnvironment(env: AgenticEnvironment): void {
99	        this.envRef = env
100	    }
101	
102	    async onContextItem(_source: Participant, item: ContextItem): Promise<void> {
103	        if (item instanceof RunStartedItem) {
104	            this.startedAtMs = Date.now()
105	            // Capture base SHA at run start so we can later list commits
106	            // produced by the run regardless of how many branches Conductor
107	            // ends up on.
108	            if (this.baseSha == null) {
109	                this.baseSha = await getHeadSha(this.opts.cwd)
110	            }
111	            const prd = this.safeLoadPrd()
112	            this.branchName = prd?.branchName ?? null
113	            return
114	        }
115	
116	        if (item instanceof LevelStartedItem) {
117	            this.levels[item.ordinal] = [...item.storyIds]
118	            for (const id of item.storyIds) {
119	                if (!this.stories.has(id)) {
120	                    this.stories.set(id, {
121	                        id,
122	                        title: "",
123	                        success: null,
124	                        durationSecs: null,
125	                        attempts: 0,
126	                        levelOrdinal: item.ordinal,
127	                    })
128	                } else {
129	                    const rec = this.stories.get(id)!
130	                    rec.levelOrdinal = item.ordinal
131	                }
132	            }
133	            return
134	        }
135	
136	        if (item instanceof StoryResultItem) {
137	            const existing = this.stories.get(item.storyId) ?? {
138	                id: item.storyId,
139	                title: "",
140	                success: null,
141	                durationSecs: null,
142	                attempts: 0,
143	                levelOrdinal: null,
144	            }
145	            existing.success = item.success
146	            existing.durationSecs = item.durationSecs
147	            existing.attempts = item.attempts
148	            this.stories.set(item.storyId, existing)
149	            return
150	        }
151	
152	        if (item instanceof RunCompletedItem) {
153	            // Track the in-flight finalize call so orchestrate.ts can
154	            // await it before emitting the TUI `done` event.
155	            this.finalizePromise = this.finalize(item)
156	            await this.finalizePromise
157	            return
158	        }
159	    }
160	
161	    /**
162	     * Resolves once Finalizer has finished handling RunCompletedItem
163	     * (PR opened, skipped, or failed). Resolves immediately if no run
164	     * has completed yet. Safe to call multiple times.
165	     */
166	    complete(): Promise<void> {
167	        return this.finalizePromise ?? Promise.resolve()
168	    }
169	
170	    private async finalize(run: RunCompletedItem): Promise<void> {
171	        if (!this.opts.createPr) return
172	
173	        if (!run.success && run.completedStories.length === 0) {
174	            this.log("[finalizer] run failed before producing any commits; skipping PR")
175	            this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(null, this.branchName ?? "", ""))
176	            return
177	        }
178	
179	        if (!(await this.hasGhBinary())) {
180	            this.log("[finalizer] `gh` not found on PATH; skipping PR creation")
181	            this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(null, this.branchName ?? "", ""))
182	            return
183	        }
184	
185	        const branch = this.branchName ?? (await this.detectBranch())
186	        if (!branch) {
187	            this.log("[finalizer] could not determine branch; skipping PR")
188	            this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(null, "", ""))
189	            return
190	        }
191	
192	        const baseBranch = await this.detectDefaultBaseBranch()
193	        if (!baseBranch) {
194	            this.log("[finalizer] could not determine base branch; skipping PR")
195	            this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(null, branch, ""))
196	            return
197	        }
198	        if (branch === baseBranch) {
199	            this.log(
200	                `[finalizer] branch '${branch}' matches base; skipping PR (run committed straight to main?)`,
201	            )
202	            this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(null, branch, baseBranch))
203	            return
204	        }
205	
206	        // Tell observers we're now in the "composing + sending PR" phase
207	        // so a UI can show a spinner / progress block instead of jumping
208	        // straight to the completion screen.
209	        this.emit(new FinalizeStartedItem(branch))
210	
211	        // Hydrate story titles from the canonical PRD that Conductor was
212	        // working from at the moment the run ended. This is important
213	        // when Surgeon replans midway through — we want the user to see
214	        // the *final* titles, not the original ones.
215	        const prd = this.safeLoadPrd()
216	        if (prd) {
217	            for (const s of prd.userStories) {
218	                const rec = this.stories.get(s.id)
219	                if (rec && !rec.title) rec.title = s.title
220	            }
221	        }
222	
223	        // Build a SHA → first-line-of-message map for everything between
224	        // the base SHA and HEAD. We can't reliably attribute commits to
225	        // stories one-to-one because some stories produce multiple
226	        // commits and some commits don't carry the story ID, but we
227	        // *can* show the user the canonical "first commit per story" by
228	        // best-effort matching on title keywords.
229	        const commits = await this.collectCommitsSinceBase()
230	
231	        const orderedStories = this.orderStories()
232	        const { passed, failed } = this.partition(orderedStories)
233	        const filesStats = await this.collectFileStats()
234	        const totalSecs = run.totalDurationSecs
235	
236	        const title = this.buildPrTitle(prd, passed.length, orderedStories.length)
237	        const body = this.buildPrBody({
238	            prd,
239	            run,
240	            orderedStories,
241	            passed,
242	            failed,
243	            commits,
244	            filesStats,
245	            totalSecs,
246	            sequentialSecs: this.sequentialSeconds(),
247	        })
248	
249	        this.log(`[finalizer] opening PR on ${baseBranch} ← ${branch}`)
250	        const url = await this.openPr({ title, body, baseBranch, branch })
251	
252	        if (url) {
253	            this.log(`[finalizer] PR opened: ${url}`)
254	        }
255	        this.emit(new PrCreatedItem(url, branch, baseBranch))
256	    }
257	
258	    // ─── Bus & env helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────
259	
260	    private emit(item: ContextItem): void {
261	        this.envRef?.deliverContextItem(this, item)
262	    }
263	
264	    private log(line: string): void {
265	        this.opts.onLog?.(line)
266	    }
267	
268	    // ─── PRD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
269	
270	    private safeLoadPrd(): PrdFile | null {
271	        try {
272	            return loadPrd(this.opts.prdPath)
273	        } catch {
274	            return null
275	        }
276	    }
277	
278	    // ─── Story ordering & partitioning ──────────────────────────────
279	
280	    /**
281	     * Stories returned in DAG order so the table reads top-down the same
282	     * way the run executed: level 0 first, then level 1, etc. Within a
283	     * level we sort by id (stable) to keep the table deterministic.
284	     */
285	    private orderStories(): StoryRecord[] {
286	        const seen = new Set<string>()
287	        const ordered: StoryRecord[] = []
288	        for (const lvl of this.levels) {
289	            const sorted = [...lvl].sort()
290	            for (const id of sorted) {
291	                const rec = this.stories.get(id)
292	                if (rec && !seen.has(id)) {
293	                    ordered.push(rec)
294	                    seen.add(id)
295	                }
296	            }
297	        }
298	        // Catch any stories Surgeon added that never made it into a
299	        // LevelStartedItem we observed.
300	        for (const [id, rec] of this.stories.entries()) {
301	            if (!seen.has(id)) ordered.push(rec)
302	        }
303	        return ordered
304	    }
305	
306	    private partition(stories: StoryRecord[]): {
307	        passed: StoryRecord[]
308	        failed: StoryRecord[]
309	    } {
310	        const passed: StoryRecord[] = []
311	        const failed: StoryRecord[] = []
312	        for (const s of stories) {
313	            if (s.success === true) passed.push(s)
314	            else if (s.success === false) failed.push(s)
315	        }
316	        return { passed, failed }
317	    }
318	
319	    private sequentialSeconds(): number {
320	        let sum = 0
321	        for (const s of this.stories.values()) {
322	            if (s.durationSecs && s.success !== false) sum += s.durationSecs
323	        }
324	        return sum
325	    }
326	
327	    // ─── Git / commits / files ──────────────────────────────────────
328	
329	    private async collectCommitsSinceBase(): Promise<
330	        { sha: string; subject: string }[]
331	    > {
332	        if (!this.baseSha) return []
333	        try {
334	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
335	                "git",
336	                ["log", `${this.baseSha}..HEAD`, "--pretty=format:%H%x09%s"],
337	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
338	            )
339	            return stdout
340	                .split("\n")
341	                .filter((l) => l.includes("\t"))
342	                .map((l) => {
343	                    const [sha, ...rest] = l.split("\t")
344	                    return { sha, subject: rest.join("\t").trim() }
345	                })
346	        } catch {
347	            return []
348	        }
349	    }
350	
351	    private async collectFileStats(): Promise<{
352	        created: number
353	        modified: number
354	    }> {
355	        if (!this.baseSha) return { created: 0, modified: 0 }
356	        try {
357	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
358	                "git",
359	                ["diff", "--name-status", this.baseSha, "HEAD"],
360	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
361	            )
362	            let created = 0
363	            let modified = 0
364	            for (const line of stdout.split("\n")) {
365	                const ch = line.charAt(0)
366	                if (ch === "A") created++
367	                else if (ch === "M" || ch === "R") modified++
368	            }
369	            return { created, modified }
370	        } catch {
371	            return { created: 0, modified: 0 }
372	        }
373	    }
374	
375	    private async detectBranch(): Promise<string | null> {
376	        try {
377	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
378	                "git",
379	                ["branch", "--show-current"],
380	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
381	            )
382	            return stdout.trim() || null
383	        } catch {
384	            return null
385	        }
386	    }
387	
388	    private async detectDefaultBaseBranch(): Promise<string | null> {
389	        // Prefer the remote's default branch from `gh repo view`. Fall
390	        // back to a `git remote show origin` parse, then to "main".
391	        try {
392	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
393	                "gh",
394	                ["repo", "view", "--json", "defaultBranchRef", "--jq", ".defaultBranchRef.name"],
395	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
396	            )
397	            const name = stdout.trim()
398	            if (name) return name
399	        } catch {
400	            // fall through
401	        }
402	        try {
403	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
404	                "git",
405	                ["symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"],
406	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
407	            )
408	            const ref = stdout.trim()
409	            if (ref.startsWith("origin/")) return ref.slice("origin/".length)
410	        } catch {
411	            // fall through
412	        }
413	        return "main"
414	    }
415	
416	    // ─── PR body composition ────────────────────────────────────────
417	
418	    private buildPrTitle(
419	        prd: PrdFile | null,
420	        passed: number,
421	        total: number,
422	    ): string {
423	        const project = prd?.project ?? "baro run"
424	        if (passed === total) {
425	            return `${project} (${total} ${total === 1 ? "story" : "stories"})`
426	        }
427	        return `${project} (${passed}/${total} stories)`
428	    }
429	
430	    private buildPrBody(args: {
431	        prd: PrdFile | null
432	        run: RunCompletedItem
433	        orderedStories: StoryRecord[]
434	        passed: StoryRecord[]
435	        failed: StoryRecord[]
436	        commits: { sha: string; subject: string }[]
437	        filesStats: { created: number; modified: number }
438	        totalSecs: number
439	        sequentialSecs: number
440	    }): string {
441	        const { prd, run, orderedStories, passed, failed, commits, filesStats } =
442	            args
443	        const lines: string[] = []
444	
445	        lines.push(
446	            `> Opened by [baro](https://baro.rs) — Mozaik-orchestrated parallel coding agents.`,
447	        )
448	        lines.push("")
449	
450	        if (prd?.description) {
451	            lines.push("## Goal")
452	            lines.push("")
453	            lines.push(prd.description.trim())
454	            lines.push("")
455	        }
456	
457	        // DAG plan
458	        if (this.levels.length > 0) {
459	            lines.push("## Plan")
460	            lines.push("")
461	            lines.push("```")
462	            for (let i = 0; i < this.levels.length; i++) {
463	                const ids = this.levels[i]
464	                lines.push(`Level ${i} ─── ${ids.join(", ")}`)
465	            }
466	            lines.push("```")
467	            lines.push("")
468	        }
469	
470	        // Stories table
471	        lines.push("## Stories")
472	        lines.push("")
473	        lines.push("| # | Story | Status | Duration | Commit |")
474	        lines.push("|---|-------|--------|----------|--------|")
475	        for (const s of orderedStories) {
476	            const title = (s.title || s.id).replace(/\|/g, "\\|")
477	            const status =
478	                s.success === true ? "✓" : s.success === false ? "✗" : "—"
479	            const dur =
480	                s.durationSecs != null ? formatDuration(s.durationSecs) : "—"
481	            const commit = matchCommit(s, commits)
482	            lines.push(
483	                `| ${s.id} | ${title} | ${status} | ${dur} | ${commit ? "`" + commit.slice(0, 7) + "`" : "—"} |`,
484	            )
485	        }
486	        lines.push("")
487	
488	        // Diff stats
489	        lines.push("## Diff stats")
490	        lines.push("")
491	        lines.push(`- **Files created**: ${filesStats.created}`)
492	        lines.push(`- **Files modified**: ${filesStats.modified}`)
493	        lines.push(`- **Total commits**: ${commits.length}`)
494	        lines.push("")
495	
496	        // Run summary
497	        lines.push("## Run summary")
498	        lines.push("")
499	        const wall = formatDuration(args.totalSecs)
500	        const seq = formatDuration(args.sequentialSecs)
501	        const speedup =
502	            args.totalSecs > 0
503	                ? (args.sequentialSecs / args.totalSecs).toFixed(2) + "×"
504	                : "—"
505	        lines.push(`- **Wall time**: ${wall}`)
506	        lines.push(`- **Sequential time**: ${seq}`)
507	        lines.push(`- **Parallel speedup**: ${speedup}`)
508	        lines.push(`- **Stories passed**: ${passed.length}/${orderedStories.length}`)
509	        lines.push(`- **Stories failed**: ${failed.length}`)
510	        lines.push(`- **Total story attempts**: ${run.totalAttempts}`)
511	        if (run.abortReason) {
512	            lines.push(`- **Abort reason**: ${run.abortReason}`)
513	        }
514	        lines.push("")
515	
516	        lines.push("---")
517	        lines.push("")
518	        lines.push("🤖 Plan. Parallelize. Review. Ship. — opened by baro")
519	
520	        return lines.join("\n")
521	    }
522	
523	    private async hasGhBinary(): Promise<boolean> {
524	        try {
525	            await execFileAsync("gh", ["--version"], { cwd: this.opts.cwd })
526	            return true
527	        } catch {
528	            return false
529	        }
530	    }
531	
532	    private async openPr(args: {
533	        title: string
534	        body: string
535	        baseBranch: string
536	        branch: string
537	    }): Promise<string | null> {
538	        try {
539	            const { stdout } = await execFileAsync(
540	                "gh",
541	                [
542	                    "pr",
543	                    "create",
544	                    "--base",
545	                    args.baseBranch,
546	                    "--head",
547	                    args.branch,
548	                    "--title",
549	                    args.title,
550	                    "--body",
551	                    args.body,
552	                ],
553	                { cwd: this.opts.cwd },
554	            )
555	            const url = stdout.trim().split("\n").pop() ?? ""
556	            return url || null
557	        } catch (e) {
558	            // If a PR already exists for this branch, gh prints to
559	            // stderr and exits non-zero. Surface the existing URL
560	            // instead of pretending the call failed.
561	            const stderr = (e as { stderr?: string })?.stderr ?? ""
562	            const existing = stderr.match(/https:\/\/github\.com\/\S+\/pull\/\d+/)?.[0]
563	            if (existing) {
564	                this.log(`[finalizer] PR already exists: ${existing}`)
565	                return existing
566	            }
567	            this.log(
568	                `[finalizer] gh pr create failed: ${stderr.split("\n")[0]?.trim() || (e as Error).message}`,
569	            )
570	            return null
571	        }
572	    }
573	}
574	
575	// ─── module-private helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────
576	
577	function formatDuration(secs: number): string {
578	    if (secs < 60) return `${Math.round(secs)}s`
579	    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60)
580	    const s = Math.round(secs % 60)
581	    return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`
582	}
583	
584	/**
585	 * Best-effort match of a commit to a story. We look for the story's id
586	 * (e.g. "S3") at word-boundaries in the commit subject, then fall back
587	 * to title-keyword overlap. Returns the first matching commit SHA, or
588	 * null if nothing plausibly belongs to this story.
589	 */
590	function matchCommit(
591	    story: StoryRecord,
592	    commits: { sha: string; subject: string }[],
593	): string | null {
594	    if (commits.length === 0) return null
595	
596	    const idPattern = new RegExp(`\\b${story.id}\\b`, "i")
597	    for (const c of commits) {
598	        if (idPattern.test(c.subject)) return c.sha
599	    }
600	
601	    if (!story.title) return null
602	    const keywords = story.title
603	        .toLowerCase()
604	        .split(/[^a-z0-9]+/)
605	        .filter((w) => w.length >= 4)
606	    if (keywords.length === 0) return null
607	
608	    let bestSha: string | null = null
609	    let bestScore = 0
610	    for (const c of commits) {
611	        const subj = c.subject.toLowerCase()
612	        const hits = keywords.reduce((n, k) => (subj.includes(k) ? n + 1 : n), 0)
613	        if (hits > bestScore) {
614	            bestScore = hits
615	            bestSha = c.sha
616	        }
617	    }
618	    return bestScore >= 2 ? bestSha : null
619	}
